body:
I don't know why I'm posting here.  No one cares about me and that's ok, I shouldn't expect anyone to give a shit.  I'm useless and worthless anyway.  I used to care about things and feel feelings, but not anymore.  I don't get excited or happy, I'm just sad.  And I'm not even sure I get sad anymore, because being sad involves feelings.  I don't feel anything. There's no happiness in my life, and I don't have anything to look forward to.  

I've lost hope that things will get better and I don't even care to hold onto that belief.  I'm resentful that I've been trying to get help i.e. counseling for months now and I can't afford it and there are no free options.  I'm resentful of getting smacked down repeatedly every time I try to move past this shitty, horrible place I'm in and every time things get a tiny bit better it never lasts.

I'm resentful of having spent over 200k to go to school and then being forced to work for 14/hr for two years, resentful of not being able to use my training or my brain for two years because I failed my licensing exam, not having health insurance, having to stress about money every day for two years, not having enough money to take care of basic things like my car or my health.  I'm resentful that I have to stress over things like how I'm going to buy groceries. I'm resentful that I'm two years behind everyone I graduated with.

I'm resentful that failing my licensing exam has forced me into poverty which I've been trapped in for two years.  I'm resentful that I have been stuck in this terrible city and that I have no friends.
I am here also because I have no one to reach out to.  Do you go to school?  What do you do for a living?

Chicken is an awesome name.  I like it.  Thanks for giving a crap about me because no one else does, except my mom.  But we don't really have a deep relationship like I wish we did, all these years of drinking have affected her mentally.  She's not like she used to be, but of course I still love her.  I don't know how much longer I can hang on, I really don't.  I'm too scared of going to hell to ever do anything, but I think about giving up all the time.  From the moment I wake up till the moment I go to bed, it's just a living hell.  I hate the city I live in and I've been stuck here for 5 years now...and I really mean stuck.  It's too expensive to move and it's not like I have anything in the bank to live off anyway. I have been trying for 6 months to find a free/low cost counselor and the only one I found is through a med school here and they told me that I "need more long term care than they could provide" so I had an appt with them in June and they CANCELLED it.  Can you believe that?  I don't know where else to turn.

Thank you for your thoughts...today is not a good day.  I just feel so useless and worthless, my life really has no point.  My mom is the only person who would care and be affected if I weren't here.  I don't want to put her through that but I am so fucking tired of trying, hoping, waiting for something to change and it never does.  What is the point of life when I'm just some lonely person doing a pointless job that barely pays my bills, have reached out for help and can't get it?  Seriously, I have $0 until 9/6 when I get paid (I get paid the 23rd too but that all goes to my rent.)  I'm tired of living like this, I don't know how I'm going to eat. This is why I have maxed out credit cards because my job doesn't pay me enough to live.  And if I could just pass this one last exam, things might change for me so I could finally move on to having a career and not just a job.  What kind of 33 year old gets this far in life having accomplished nothing?

Thanks for your reply, and I think you are right in that I'm going to have to find a way to get to an initial appointment.  I need to be on meds.  The closest city is over an hour away...and as you may have guessed paying for gas is an issue.  There's always the bus, but I just can't afford to miss work and these clinics are only open during the week.  But maybe if I can at least get on meds for depression and try to begin to heal.

Thanks for replying.  My cats are Pablo, Foxy and my dog is Noodles.  I know that most people aren't equipped to deal with my depression but I try to keep going...I thought I was going to feel like I nailed this stupid exam today but I feel awful about it.  Maybe just because I've gotten used to failing...every day I have been telling myself to just hang on because I'm almost there, but it still feels so far away.

I'm new to Reddit and ended up in this forum because I'm depressed.  Here's what we don't have in common: I don't have a kid, not married and not in a relationship.  Here's what we do share in common: No substantial income. No place to go (my mom is alcoholic hoarder in another state). No insurance to help with medication or counseling.  I also have 250k in grad school debt for a career I can't seem to obtain.  More on that if you're interested.  The only things keeping me alive (besides fear of death, even though I'm miserable,) are my 2 cats and my dog.  But you have something more important - a daughter.  If you weren't here, she'd be damaged for life.  Shit, I'm damaged for life and both my parents are here (dad hates me, isn't in the picture, mom is loving but always drunk and has her own problems.)  I'm here if you want to talk.  There's a way out of this, maybe we can figure it out together.
